src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: 2011 congressional plan, 16 districts (Am. Sub. House Bill 369, 129th General Assembly)
U.S. District Court, S.D. Ohio, Ohio A. Philip Randolph Institute v. Householder, No. 1:18-cv-357, ECF 212-1, joint uncontroverted facts (HB 369 passed 2011-12-14, signed 2011-12-15)

Passed 2011-12-14, signed 2011-12-15 together with a single primary election. HB 369 replaced HB 319 (signed 2011-09-26), which a referendum petition had put at risk. In force 2012-2020. The cd116 file has 16 districts.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2011 General Assembly district plan, 33 Senate districts (Ohio Apportionment Board)
Supreme Court of Ohio (Court News Ohio): Supreme Court upholds 2011 legislative redistricting plan as constitutional (Wilson v. Kasich, 2012)

The Apportionment Board approved the plan 2011-09-28 (final amendment 2011-09-30, 4-0) and filed it with the Secretary of State in September 2011; the Ohio Supreme Court upheld it in 2012. Even-numbered Senate districts were up in 2020 (16 contests in the record). The 2020 file (LSY 2018) holds it, plus an extra ZZZ record for Lake Erie.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2011 General Assembly district plan, 99 House districts (Ohio Apportionment Board)
Supreme Court of Ohio (Court News Ohio): Supreme Court upholds 2011 legislative redistricting plan as constitutional (Wilson v. Kasich, 2012)
Same board plan as the Senate map. The 2020 file (LSY 2018) holds it, plus an extra ZZZ record for Lake Erie (100 records, 99 districts).
